title: video.deleted.v1
description: Video deleted by its owner. Written to the videos service outbox in the same transaction as the deletion mark; delivered to each subscriber (analysis, comments, likes) as a separate row. Subscribers delete related data idempotently. Topic name: video.deleted.v1; partition key: videoId. Compatibility: only adding optional fields.

eventId.description: Event ID; the consumer deduplicates by it and by videoId.

traceId.description: W3C trace id; may be absent.

ownerId.description: Keycloak sub of the owner who deleted the video.
